<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 450 450" width="450" height="450">
  <rect width="450" height="450" fill="#fff"/>
  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#000">
    <rect x="100" y="40" width="250" height="350" rx="25" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="4"/>
    <rect x="112" y="52" width="226" height="326" rx="18" fill="#e6e6e6" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="225" cy="230" rx="60" ry="85" fill="#fff" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="290" cy="100" r="30" fill="#aaa" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="295" cy="102" r="10" fill="#444" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g fill="#8c8c8c" stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.2">
      <ellipse cx="145" cy="80" rx="15" ry="9"/>
      <ellipse cx="205" cy="75" rx="15" ry="9"/>
      <ellipse cx="150" cy="150" rx="15" ry="9"/>
      <ellipse cx="140" cy="230" rx="15" ry="9"/>
      <ellipse cx="150" cy="310" rx="15" ry="9"/>
      <ellipse cx="185" cy="355" rx="15" ry="9"/>
      <ellipse cx="265" cy="355" rx="15" ry="9"/>
      <ellipse cx="305" cy="320" rx="15" ry="9"/>
      <ellipse cx="310" cy="230" rx="15" ry="9"/>
      <ellipse cx="305" cy="170" rx="15" ry="9"/>
    </g>
    <g stroke="#000" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none">
      <line x1="50" y1="215" x2="100" y2="215"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="130" x2="112" y2="130"/>
      <line x1="325" y1="230" x2="400" y2="230"/>
      <line x1="320" y1="100" x2="400" y2="100"/>
      <line x1="255" y1="270" x2="400" y2="270"/>
    </g>
    <text x="30" y="221" text-anchor="middle">A</text>
    <text x="30" y="136" text-anchor="middle">B</text>
    <text x="420" y="236" text-anchor="middle">C</text>
    <text x="420" y="106" text-anchor="middle">D</text>
    <text x="420" y="276" text-anchor="middle">E</text>
    <text x="225" y="428" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Fig. 1.1</text>
  </g>
</svg>
